page: Amazon Web Services c8gd.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the Nitro Hypervisor, powered by AWS ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processors. It provides 96 dedicated physical cores running at 2.8 GHz without hyperthreading, alongside 192.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per core). Local fast storage is provided through a 5,700 GB NVMe SSD setup, while networking features a baseline throughput of 40 Gbps. No GPUs are attached to this instance.

Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier multi-threaded processing, evidenced by a multi-core stress-ng metric of 163,583.92 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 26,012.0. Memory throughput reaches 480.66 GB/sec for uncached large reads and 201.46 GB/sec for writes. The instance excels in parallel operations such as Clang software compilation, PassMark database operations, and Redis SET operations (195.84 million operations/sec). However, single-core metrics remain moderate, with average-tier scores across single-threaded stress-ng, Geekbench, and gzip compression.

Given its combination of dense multi-core ARM architecture, direct NVMe storage, and high networking capacity, the c8gd.24xlarge offers strong qualitative resource efficiency for parallel workloads that do not rely on x86 vector extensions. It is well-fitted for large-scale distributed databases, high-throughput caching tiers, CI/CD code compilation pipelines, and static web serving.
